entities.summary: Henri Drell is an Estonian professional basketball player for Joventut Badalona of the Spanish Liga ACB. He also represents the Estonian national basketball team internationally. Standing 2.05 metres, he mainly plays as a small forward. He is also the second Estonian player to ever play in the NBA.
